Quick technical note before the kickoff:

Based on Anita’s usage snapshot I sketched a sizing estimate and a short runbook for the uplift. High-level suggestions:
- Dedicated GPU pool sized for 2.5x steady-state tokens -> estimated 3.5x peak headroom (attached workbook).
- Canary rollout plan: start with 20% of traffic on the dedicated pool for the first two weeks, watch latency/99th percentile and cache hit rates, then ramp to full commit.
- If you want lower unit cost we can apply the Quantization-High throughput profile (loses negligible quality for embeddings use-cases).

I attached sizing-estimate-v2.xlsx with the capacity table and cost delta between monthly vs quarterly billing. Will walk through the numbers on Wed.

Cheers,
